captions.detailed: A children's tabletop toy telescope consisting of a blue and white main refractor tube mounted on a simple alt-azimuth tripod. The tripod base is supported by three silver-colored curved legs tipped with black feet, connected to a central column and a black rotating mount. The telescope tube tilts vertically on a revolute altitude joint supported by a black fork-style bracket, while the mount rotates horizontally on a continuous azimuth bearing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a children's tabletop refractor telescope on a tripod. The model must feature a blue-and-white optical tube assembly with an eyepiece and lens caps, mounted on a black dual-axis alt-azimuth fork head. The tripod must have three silver legs with black rubber feet, and the assembly should include a continuous azimuth rotation joint and a revolute altitude tilt joint.
captions.factory: The telescope model is built by defining three main parts: a base, a mount, and a tube. The base is constructed from cylinder primitives for the central column, combined with three curved leg sweeps (or extruded arcs) rotated 120 degrees apart, tipped with small cylinders for feet. The mount is created using a main rotation hub (cylinder) and a fork bracket (combining a flat rectangular base with two vertical side-posts). The tube is assembled from coaxial cylinders representing the main blue body, white decorative rings, a front objective lens cap, a tapered rear adapter, and a bent eyepiece tube. Finally, a continuous joint is defined between the base and the mount around the Z-axis, and a revolute joint is defined between the mount and the tube around the Y-axis.
